summary: Sub-factor weightage (Phase A) + sub-factor assessment rollup (Phase B) tested end-to-end on the BACKEND for the Pros & Cons flow. All 5 new pytest cases pass (5/5 = 100%): (1) PUT /api/pros-cons/{id}/factors/{factor_id} persists `weight`; (2) weighted-average rollup (80%@70 + 20%@40 → 64% → cell_value matches std_rating*0.64); (3) equal-mean rollup when sub weights are 0 ((100+50)/2 = 75%); (4) parent fallback when no sub is assessed (uses main factor's own assessment_pct); (5) mandatory knockout disqualifies the option when the ROLLED-UP pct is below threshold (40% < 60% → disqualified=True, main factor in disqualifying_factor_ids). Frontend landing page boots cleanly (no console errors, mobile viewport 390x844). Step 2 / Step 5 weight UI and Step 7 sub-factor rollup UI were NOT deep-clicked because their inputs lack testIDs — see action items.

effectiveFactorPct in decisionHelpers.ts mirrors the same 3-branch logic on the frontend, ensuring the option Worth % aggregation in Step 7 matches what the backend computes for Pros & Cons — good parity.
